desc: Everything about the Shoreline is comfortable, easy-to-use, and reliable. The 3D-contoured, fine textured handle fits in the hand for effective and comfortable cutting work. Snappy assisted action opens the blade, and a bias toward the closed position keeps it safely stored until you need it. The Shoreline uses easy-to-sharpen 8Cr13MoV blade steel. And a reversible deep-carry clip with flush screws rests snugly in your pocket. The Shoreline doesn't overthink it. It's a no-nonsense work knife for everyday carry.
